title: Prove nilpotent Schur residual normal form and fixed-H weights (no κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For **nilpotent H**, this closes the whole-residual extension question left by #5256. Fix a commuting idempotent pair, its four joint-sector dimensions, a common identity-block deletion and the exact compressed product H. If the Schur commutator has maximal rank 2d, the entire ordered residual pair has **one simultaneous-conjugacy orbit**. The package gives its all-field representative and its exact fixed-H split/header weight.

In odd characteristic, every H Jordan block of size k produces central blocks of sizes **k and k+1**, together with explicitly specified scalar summands. Thus the motivating ternary H=J3 example has whole central blocks **(4,3,1,1,1)**: the extra length-four attachment is determined, rather than merely bounded by an annihilator. An explicit coordinate isomorphism proves the full ordered-pair statement, including the complement of the commutator image.

For profile r=(d+s00,d+s10,d+s01,d+a+s11), a=nullity H, the number of sharp splits with this **exact H** is

```text
N_H = product_j |GL_(r_j)(F_q)| /
      (product_j |GL_(s_j)(F_q)| q^(a²+2a s11)).
```

There are N_H |GL_(n-d)(F_q)| complete ordered headers. These all reach the same residual orbit, but other H may reach it too: this is **fixed-H event mass**, not unconditional state mass. The Jordan formula requires odd characteristic; the all-field representative, rigidity and count include characteristic two.

Only the five files in `research/schur-nilpotent-extension/` are added. Claim type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. The generic factor-equivalence and stabilizer methods are credited premises; the new work is their Schur specialization, explicit complementary attachment and full central Jordan law. No new dimension minimum, general-H classifier, physical supplier, κ or selected-frontier change.

The missing obligation was the whole extension beyond im K, rather than another seed of the completed dimension/count/census work.

The archived source bytes are pinned in SOURCES.json; the pending helper's exact blob/hash and further lineage heads are in TASK.json. A merge into the archive is not scientific acceptance.

Final overlap covers all 7,091 tracked in-scope notes, 327 open PR bodies (2026-10-23 14:49 UTC) and 4,530 Discussion records (14:52 UTC), with complete pagination and no coverage warnings. The other open Schur matches concern P112 diagonal completion (#5249) and downset inertia (#5247). No competing extension result was found within coverage. Arbitrary diffs, nested notes, exhaustive closed-PR bodies and unpublished work remain outside coverage; targeted all-state searches supplement the initial snapshot. No literature-wide novelty claim.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.11 / macOS arm64; standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/schur-nilpotent-extension
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/schur-nilpotent-extension --check-source-history
```

- Both registered isolated, warning-strict normal and optimized replays pass, with identical scientific stdout and explicit exception-based checks.
- All **834 nilpotent H** in complete domains d=1,2,3 over F2/F3 and d=1,2 over F5 pass literal full-matrix Schur/coordinate checks. All **765 odd-field cases** also verify the core and full central rank sequence.
- **45 padded fixtures** check the ordered scalar decomposition and construct actual factor/header/residual intertwiners, including multiple nilpotent Jordan blocks.
- **Five exhaustive split inventories** test the sector criterion against literal Schur ranks and transport every one of the **188 sharp outcomes** to its canonical ordered pair. The ternary scalar case has 128 passing splits and 3,105,423,360 complete headers.
- **Six independent sector-factor censuses** check the stabilizer denominator; **nine rejection controls** cover the characteristic-two overclaim, omitted extended chain/exponents, nonsquare/nonnilpotent H, negative padding and deficient factor rank.
- All five committed files and source-history pins pass. Official export/integrity checks pass at the exact head above. The affected-package planner selects only this package.
- Both isolated export replays pass outside Git with `PATH=/nonexistent`, read-only files/directories and unchanged hashes for all six exported files (including the receipt): 3.26s normal / 3.27s optimized. These are replay durations, not algorithmic performance claims.

Export SHA256: `7fe8a9bff73c8eb41f6ae2a8d829e5e9608ecfabf3d06bb497b565e39e8b1f4f`.
Scientific stdout SHA256: `ba358675b3031aef57895701547380f864223c83ef89a9f44f039714f1a97fa0`.
[Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39973965832) at the exact contribution head is `in_progress` at handoff; no hosted pass is claimed. This is separate from the completed local checks.

The all-field/prime-power theorem rests on the written argument; the executable checks are finite prime-field corroboration. Independent human/proof-kernel acceptance, Lean, Docker and selected scientific cold replay are unclaimed. Prior source-binding orientation stopped on a sparse-omitted checkpoint; it was not a baseline pass.

## Open next questions

The README gives a bounded characteristic-two question: start with its all-field model for H=J2/J3 and derive the full central partition without division by two. No claim is held. Unconditional or later-guard state weights should wait for a named consumer/header distribution and cost allowance. Physical cover, selection/emission, reads, owned/borrowed state, dirty restoration, precision, storage, stock, dispatch and the complete consumer bill remain unknown, not zero. Stop this branch at the present result without that contract.
